blocks.text: Need faucet repair or installation in Terrell Hills, TX? Whether it’s a slow drip or a full replacement, Rosenberg Plumbing & Air handles it. Leaking faucets waste water and wear out sinks and countertops. Low pressure or faulty handles are also common signs that something’s wrong. If a faucet breaks entirely, you don’t have time to wait.

Our team serves both residential and commercial customers in Terrell Hills and nearby areas. We fix kitchen faucets, bathroom faucets, laundry room faucets, and more. If it runs water, we can repair or replace it. We also install new faucets for remodels or upgrades. Modern features like touch sensors and pull-down sprayers can enhance your lifestyle and save water, lowering your bills. We’ll make sure everything fits your setup and functions correctly.
Terrell Hills Faucet Repair and Installation Pros

A dripping faucet can waste hundreds of gallons a year. Hidden corrosion, damaged seals, or worn cartridges are usually the cause. We inspect the faucet, identify the exact issue, and handle the repair before costly repairs are necessary.

In some cases, repairs don’t make sense. If the faucet is cracked, outdated, or leaking at the base, new faucet installation may be the better option. We’ll explain what’s going on and give you a clear path forward. Whether you’re remodeling or just updating old fixtures, we’ll match the faucet to your sink, water lines, and usage needs. That includes standard two-handle setups, single-handle faucets, and high-efficiency designs.

We work with major brands and know which models last. We also keep common parts stocked, which speeds up both repairs and installs. That means you won’t need to have us take multiple trips or spend multiple service calls repairing your faucet.
